sources.snippet: Overview gemma-3-4b-it is a 4-billion-parameter instruction-tuned multimodal model from google-deepmind that processes both text and images to generate text responses. Built on the same research and technology as Google's Gemini models, it features a 128K token context window, multilingual support across 140+ languages, and is optimized for following instructions.
